verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs say every review comment has a 'Fix with your Agent' button that sends file paths, line numbers and suggested code to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Conductor or Devin, and a 'Fix All' button sends every issue at once. Its official MCP server also lets Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code and Codex fetch and resolve unaddressed comments, which supports iterative auto-fix loops ('Greplooping'). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent hand-off works as documented.
